findings.defect: 달포 뒤 means about a month and a half later, so the translation shortens the stated time until the ceremony.
findings.rationale: The source gives a 달포, approximately one and a half months, as the time remaining before the ceremony.
findings.replacement: only about a month and a half away

summary: One quantity is misstated: the ceremony is about a month and a half away, not about a month.
